decision: closed_no_credit: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use.
summary: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. The only source (33086877) pooled 10 placebo-controlled RCTs of repeated valerian dosing and found no significant effect on subjective sleep quality (g 0.36, 95% CI -0.08 to 0.81; I2 85%, likely missing studies); only a 4-study whole-root subgroup reached significance. The evidence does not support the record's sleep claim at a credit-bearing level, so the record becomes reference-only, which removes Evidence points from valerian products.

identity.plant_part: root/rhizome (whole herbal substance or hydroalcoholic/aqueous extracts)

population.description: Review of 60 studies (n=6894; ages 7-80); sleep meta-analysis of 10 placebo-controlled RCTs with repeated dosing; populations not specified by the authors.

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review with meta-analyses (Hedges' g) of placebo-controlled trials regardless of Jadad quality; includes observational studies and herbal combinations in the narrative review.

outcomes.name: Subjective sleep quality, 10 RCTs: pooled g 0.36 (95% CI -0.08 to 0.81), I2 85.33%, funnel plot suggests missing studies; not significant
Subgroup: whole root/rhizome g 0.83 (0.03 to 1.62, 4 studies) versus extracts g 0.10 (-0.02 to 0.22, 6 studies)
Anxiety: positive outcomes in 6 of 7 single-herb studies (narrative); preparations and doses vary

limitations: The pooled sleep-quality effect is not statistically significant; the whole-root advantage comes from a 4-study subgroup and is hypothesis-generating. No credit follows.
Trials were pooled irrespective of quality, heterogeneity was high and publication bias is suggested; target populations were not specified (Discussion).
No serious adverse events in 60 studies is not proof of universal safety; paradoxical stimulation reported in a minority.
Do not grant the whole-root hypothesis or combination effects to every extract.
